_format: buildings: { <feature uid (or pf_uid / id — the UID the info panel shows)>: { name, sources[], notes, set: {props merged onto the feature}, phases: [ {props merged over the original feature} ] } }. `set` is for plain corrections (e.g. a born date). Each phase becomes its own feature with the same footprint. base_floors = the storey the phase's volume starts at. born/died are completion/removal dates; construction_months overrides the size-based build time; died_by: 'fire' shows it burning. date_precision records how exact the dates are ('year' = mid-year placeholder). wall_color (in set or a phase) fixes the wall colour: a name from CONFIG.palettes.named (darkRed, red, orangeRed, buff, cream, tyndall, sandstone, grey) or a hex string like '#A0452E'. Survives merge_assessment.py regenerating the GeoJSON. wall_stripes adds stone/brick bands over the wall colour: a colour alone (one band per storey on the floor lines), or {color, every, height, offset, base} in metres (base = solid course at the bottom). roof_type 'dome', 'bell' (ogee) or 'conical' gives a curved tower roof; roof_height (m) and roof_color (named colour incl. slate/copper/newCopper, or hex) are optional. portico {bearing (compass ° the face looks), columns, diameter, base (stylobate m), span [u0,u1] along the face, out (m in front of the wall), height?, color?} adds a colonnade. names: [[from, to, name], …] (decimal years; to null = still) — the name the info panel shows in the view year, when a building was renamed; name stays the default. remove: true drops the feature entirely (duplicate or bad model).
